subject: Refactor RDP protocol initialization and enhance error handling; update launch configurations
body: Refactor RDP protocol initialization and enhance error handling; update launch configurations

security_flags.reason: a new or repointed package can pull arbitrary code at restore time

triage.rationale: Mixed bag: useful init/connect failure logging, but interop assembly-preload hack dubious on .NET 10; our RdpProtocol heavily diverged. Cherry-pick logging only if needed.

votes.concern: Manual LoadFrom probing duplicates interop assemblies and guarantees false MSTSCLib warnings, risking RDP type-resolution regressions without an evidenced loading bug.
votes.reason: The commit conflicts with the fork’s async path, existing diagnostics, assembly layout, exception semantics, and canonical build tooling.

votes.concern: Dynamic loading of interop assemblies via LoadFrom can cause assembly context mismatches and instability in .NET 10.
votes.reason: The change conflicts with our .NET 10 SDK-style project, lacks InitializeAsync integration, and contains localized/VS Code-specific launch configurations.

dissent: codex: REJECT - The commit conflicts with the fork’s async path, existing diagnostics, assembly layout, exception semantics, and canonical build tooling.
gemini: REJECT - The change conflicts with our .NET 10 SDK-style project, lacks InitializeAsync integration, and contains localized/VS Code-specific launch configurations.
